thread:
emma.marketing: Final draft of the product launch blog is ready for approvals — need to lock headline voice, benchmarks language, and CTA->webinar mapping. Target publish Wed 3pm PT. Doc: https://docs.google.com/draft-launch-v2

 taylor.writer: Got it. I put two hero angles in the doc: technical (latency/cost bullets) vs benefit-led. I slightly favored benefit-led in the lead para. Thoughts?

 rajesh.product: Lean benefit-led for headline but include a one-line kicker: "unified runtime + predictable economics". For numbers call out "up to 3x lower latency" and "~40% lower per-token cost" and include a methodology caveat. I'll drop the benchmark CSV into the appendix.

 olivia.legal: Please add an inline link to test methodology and a concise caveat: "Results from internal benchmarks; results vary by model and workload." Also: any registration must use explicit opt-in language (no auto-enroll).

 taylor.writer: Added caveat and methodology link: https://internal.redwood/bench/launch-2024. Drafted registration microcopy: "By registering you consent to receive product updates and webinar info. You can unsubscribe anytime." OK?

 olivia.legal: Change phrasing to "opt in" not "consent" and add checkbox copy: "I opt in to receive emails about product news and the Redwood webinar." Confirm we only collect business email + job_title.

 taylor.writer: Updated checkbox text and trimmed fields. HubSpot mapping snippet added to the doc:
```
formId: 'hs_launch_2024',
fields: ['email','company','job_title'],
list: 'Blog Launch - Webinar',
tags: ['source:blog','campaign:launch_may24']
```
UTM example: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_may24&utm_medium=referral`

 anna.analytics: For GA tracking add event `blog_launch_cta_click` with event_category = 'launch_blog'. Also fire `lead_submitted` on the registration success page with `formId` as label. I'll add the GTM trigger in staging.

 sam.ops: Ops runbook ready. Quick reminder: scheduled publish job must be created >=48 hours before target and include a rollback snippet. I'll need the final slug and SRE on-call for the publish window.

 noah.design: Hero comps v3 uploaded (abstract latency graph + product screenshot). My pick is colorway B for contrast. Mobile crop tested; alt text included.

 emma.marketing: Timeline check: legal + analytics signoff today, design pick by EOD, final copy freeze tomorrow 10am PT, ops schedule at 10:30am. If that works I'll /schedule-publish then. Any blockers?

 rajesh.product: No blockers from product. Numbers verified against internal runs.

 olivia.legal: Signed off on microcopy and benchmark caveat. No other redlines.

 anna.analytics: Approved for tracking and UTMs. Will push GTM changes to staging after final slug.

 taylor.writer: Final copy freeze set in the doc; I'll push edits and tag the group.

 deploy-bot: Reminder: publish jobs must be scheduled >=172800 seconds before target time. Use `/schedule-publish`.

 emma.marketing: Thanks team — locking thread. Drop any last comments in the doc and I'll do a final sweep at 5pm PT. :seedling:
